battle.name: 第二次突厥-波斯戰爭
battle.theater: 高加索山脈與美索不達米亞
battle.brief: 公元619年，薩珊波斯與拜占庭開戰第七年，東方突厥可汗庭乘薩珊主力西調、與拜占庭相持於兩河之際，集結騎兵自高加索關口南下，兵鋒直抵泰西封近郊，迫使薩珊以歲幣換退兵。卡面羅馬短劍距本役約七百年，未隨軍而至，然拜占庭步兵近身仍靠盾緣頂開與刺突節奏，與卡面短劍的用法一脈相承。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 本役是拜占庭—薩珊戰爭（公元602至628年）北線上的一場突厥—薩珊衝突，交戰一方是控馭蒙古高原與中亞草原的東方突厥可汗庭，另一方是坐鎮伊朗高原的薩珊波斯。突厥的軍隊是可汗庭的部族聯盟：平時各部散牧於草原，戰時由可汗集結於牙帳，兵種以弓騎兵為骨幹，輔以披甲重騎、少量步卒與隨軍工匠，並徵用粟特、漢地俘虜與歸附部眾充實行列；號令由可汗、葉護、啜、俟斤逐級下達，戰場上多支部隊同時發動而彼此不相策應。薩珊則是中央集權的重裝軍國，決策中心在泰西封，國王胡斯勞二世以王中之王的身分兼統三軍，全國分區駐防，邊區由世襲貴族或地方首長領兵；其騎兵團人數可觀，步兵以長矛手與弓箭手為骨幹，另有禁軍與象兵。亞美尼亞軍團瓦罕·馬米科尼揚部以客軍身分站在突厥一側，拜占庭皇帝希拉克里奧斯則是薩珊西線最大威脅。北線能否打崩，取決於薩珊有沒有餘力同時頂住東西兩個方向。
countriesEn: This engagement was a Turkic–Sasanian clash on the northern front of the Byzantine–Sasanian War of 602–628. One side was the Eastern Turkic Khaganate, which controlled the steppes of the Mongolian plateau and Central Asia; the other was Sasanian Persia, master of the Iranian plateau. The Turkic army was a tribal confederation under the khagan: in peacetime each clan grazed its own pastures, and in wartime the khagan mustered them at his encampment. Its backbone was light and heavy horse archers, supported by armoured cavalry, a limited infantry element and the craftsmen who travelled with the horde, while Sogdian, Chinese and other subject peoples were folded into the ranks. Orders travelled down through the khagan, the yabghu, the chuo and the siken, and on the battlefield many columns acted at once without really coordinating with one another. Sasanian Persia, by contrast, was a centralised, heavily armoured military monarchy whose decisions were made at Ctesiphon. King Khosrow II, styling himself King of Kings, commanded the three armies personally; the realm was divided into regional commands held by hereditary nobles or local magnates, cavalry formed a large fraction of the field armies, and the foot was built on pike and bow, with the elite guard and war elephants as well. The Armenian forces of Vahan Mamikonian served as auxiliaries on the Turkic side, while the Byzantine emperor Heraclius remained the greatest threat to Persia in the west. Whether the northern front collapsed depended on whether Sasanian Persia could hold two fronts at once.
people: 北方的主導者是突厥可汗父子：統葉可汗在位時與拜占庭保持同盟，一度把薩珊的亞美尼亞與亞塞拜然走廊打得難以喘息；公元610年他被自己的部眾殺死，由其弟頡畢可汗（又譯沙缽可汗）接位，頡畢可汗自此成為619年起這場戰爭的北方主帥。薩珊方面的關鍵人物是國王胡斯勞二世，他在位二十九年窮兵黷武；前線先後由沙赫巴拉茲、沙欣、法魯赫·霍爾米茲德領兵，公元622年之後改由魯斯塔姆·法魯赫扎德出任大將，他是薩珊晚期最能戰的名將，卻於公元627年12月敗於希拉克里奧斯之手。拜占庭方面的核心是皇帝希拉克里奧斯，他以小股騎兵與沿底格里斯河逆行的船隊奇襲兩河，焚掠達斯塔基爾德，逼得胡斯勞二世一度企圖渡海逃走；六一九年時他仍是拜占庭的共治皇帝之一，但實權已在手中。此外，拜占庭編年史家狄奧菲拉克特·西莫卡塔的記述，是今日了解本役部署、進攻次序與談判細節的主要依據，他本人便在六二〇年代的君士坦丁堡任職。
peopleEn: The driving figures in the north were father and son of the Turkic khaganate: while Tong Yabghu Qaghan ruled, he kept an alliance with Byzantium and repeatedly beat up Sasanian Armenia and the corridor of Caucasian Albania. In 610 he was killed by his own people, and his brother Shebi Khan (also rendered Sha Po) succeeded him; Shebi Khan became the commander on the northern side from 619 onward. The key Sasanian figure was King Khosrow II, who reigned for twenty-nine years and never stopped waging war; the front was led in turn by Shahrbaraz, Shahin and Farrukh Hormizd, and from 622 the command passed to Rostam Farrokhzad, the most capable general of late Sasanian Persia, who was nonetheless defeated by Heraclius in December 627. On the Byzantine side the central figure was the emperor Heraclius, who struck deep into the Tigris with a small cavalry force and a fleet moving upstream, sacked Dastagird and at one point forced Khosrow II to think of escaping by sea; in 619 he was still only one of the co-emperors, but the real power was already in his hands. Also crucial is the Byzantine chronicler Theophylact Simocatta, whose account is the principal source for the deployments, the order of advance and the negotiations of this war; he himself held office in Constantinople in the 620s.
kits: 卡面這把羅馬短劍屬公元前一世紀，劍身約六十公分，刃寬而近直，兩面開刃，護手簡略，握柄纏皮，通體約一公斤上下；它是羅馬軍團百人隊制式配給的側兵器，用途不是揮砍，而是配合大盾的邊緣與節奏性刺擊，在接戰最緊密的瞬間尋隙下手。公元619年的北線上，這把劍本身不在場：羅馬短劍在帝國晚期已被更長的雙刃長劍取代，拜占庭重步兵的標準配備是長劍、矛與圓盾，但格鬥邏輯原封不動地延續下來。薩珊步兵的近戰主力是長逾兩米的直矛，列成方陣正面迎敵，輔以短直刀與小型圓盾；重騎兵用矛與圓盾，弓手配角筋複合弓，鎧甲以鱗甲與札甲為主。突厥全軍裝備以角弓與短刀為主，重騎加馬鎧，馬兵另備長矛與套索。攻城方面，薩珊備有撞車、攻城塔與配重投石機，並在六二〇年代出動象兵；拜占庭則以配重投石機與水軍沿底格里斯河推進，北方方向則靠德溫、德爾本特等城牆與關隘堡壘封鎖通道。
kitsEn: The gladius on the card belongs to the first century BCE. Its blade is about sixty centimetres long, broad and nearly straight, sharpened on both edges, with a simple guard and a wrapped grip, and the whole weapon weighs around a kilogram. It was the standard side-arm issued to the Roman centuries, and its purpose was not to chop but to thrust in rhythm behind the rim of the large shield, finding a gap at the moment the lines came closest together. In 619 this sword was not present on the northern front: the gladius had been superseded in the late empire by the longer double-edged spatha, and the standard kit of Byzantine heavy infantry was spatha, spear and round shield, yet the logic of close combat carried over unchanged. The Sasanian foot fought mainly with straight spears more than two metres long, drawn up in phalanx to meet the enemy head on, supported by short straight swords and small round shields; heavy cavalry used spear and round shield, archers used horn-and-sinew composite bows, and armour was mostly scale and lamellar. The Turkic army was equipped above all with composite bows and short sabres, with armoured riders and their horses, and horsemen also carried lances and lassos. On the siege side Persia had battering rams, siege towers and counterweight trebuchets, and fielded war elephants in the 620s; Byzantium answered with counterweight trebuchets and a river fleet working up the Tigris, while on the northern axis the passes were sealed by the walls of Dvin and Derbent and the fortresses along the Caucasian routes.
tactics: 突厥的戰法是草原式的：全軍展開為寬闊的散兵線，弓騎前置反覆射擊，誘使敵軍前鋒離開陣位，然後以重騎自側翼兜回、從兩翼包抄；遇上正面堅城與高山則不強攻，改以圍城和掠取畜群糧倉為主，速戰速離。薩珊的應對倚重三樣東西：一是亞美尼亞與高加索一線的山地要塞與德溫等城垣，把突厥重騎限制在狹窄通道裏；二是重裝騎兵團與長矛步兵方陣的正面硬度；三是外交，即以金銀與歲幣換對方退兵。拜占庭的戰術最富機動性：公元613年後皇帝親率小股騎兵與水軍溯底格里斯河而上，晝夜兼程直取薩珊腹心，在達斯塔基爾德焚毀王都積藏，迫使胡斯勞二世一度企圖由海路北逃。補給線方面，薩珊靠德溫城牆、霍斯勞一世修築的德爾本特關牆與裏海沿岸的驛傳把前方連到泰西封；突厥的前進則依賴春夏草場與馬群補給，一旦深入冬境或缺馬，便難以久駐。
tacticsEn: Turkish tactics were those of the steppe. The whole horde was spread into a broad skirmish line, the light horse archers opened with repeated shooting, drew the enemy vanguard out of formation, and then the armoured cavalry swung back through the flanks to envelop the disordered enemy; faced with a solid walled city or with mountains, they did not force the issue, but sat down before the place and took livestock and stores instead, striking fast and leaving quickly. Sasanian counter-measures rested on three things. First, the mountain fortresses and city walls of the Armenian and Caucasian line, which confined the Turkic heavy horse to narrow defiles. Second, the frontal hardness of the armoured cavalry and of the pike phalanx. Third, diplomacy: paying the horde in gold and silver and in annual tribute to make it withdraw. Byzantine tactics were the most mobile of the three. After 613 the emperor rode with a small cavalry force and a river fleet up the Tigris, marching day and night straight at the Sasanian heartland, burning the royal treasure at Dastagird and driving Khosrow II to contemplate flight by sea. On the logistics, Sasanian Persia held the northern front together through the walls of Dvin, through the passes of Derbent rebuilt under Khosrow I, and through the relay posts that linked the frontier to Ctesiphon; the Turkic advance in turn depended on the summer pastures and on remounts, and once deep in winter country or short of horses, it could not be prolonged.
data: 時間線上有幾個可以核對的節點：拜占庭—薩珊戰爭自公元602年打到628年，共二十六年；本役北線的公開衝突自619年起，到628年胡斯勞二世被廢、阿達希爾二世即位後與突厥議和才告一段落，若把議和後的納貢與聯姻安排算入，前後約十二年。距離是這一役的關鍵變量：從德爾本特關口南下到大不里士約四百五十公里，再沿裏海南岸下行至泰西封另有約七百公里，突厥騎兵可在夏秋完成這樣的縱深打擊，而薩珊的後方運糧線卻長達數百公里。兵數方面，薩珊方面的材料常說全軍騎兵約佔三分之一至一半；拜占庭編年史記載薩珊軍隊達百萬之眾，現代史家多視為誇大之辭，不宜直接引用。錢財方面，狄奧菲拉克特記載，公元607年薩珊朝廷為促使突厥退兵，每日支付一萬第納爾，此數目常被用來說明當時薩珊的財政窘迫。
dataEn: Several points on the chronology can be checked. The Byzantine–Sasanian War ran from 602 to 628, twenty-six years in all. The openly fought northern phase of this war begins in 619 and ends only after Khosrow II was deposed in 628 and Ardashir II settled with the Turks; counting the tribute and marriage arrangements that followed the settlement, the whole business spans about twelve years. Distance was the decisive variable of this campaign: roughly four hundred and fifty kilometres south from the pass of Derbent to Tabriz, and a further seven hundred kilometres along the Caspian shore to Ctesiphon. Turkic horsemen could strike that deep in a single summer campaign, whereas the Sasanian supply line behind them stretched for hundreds of kilometres. On numbers, Sasanian material speaks of cavalry making up around a third to a half of the field army, and Byzantine chronicles talk of Sasanian armies of a million men; modern historians generally treat the latter as rhetorical inflation and decline to quote it as fact. On money, Theophylact records that in 607 the Sasanian court paid ten thousand dinars a day to buy off the Turks, a figure often used to show how pinched the Persian treasury had become.
cause: 直接導火線落在619年：薩珊朝廷扣下或殺害了突厥派來的使節與依附薩珊的突厥王公，斷絕了此前的歲幣與牧地安排，兩口子就此翻臉。關於翻臉的具體經過，史料說法不一：拜占庭方面的記載偏重薩珊廷刻薄、拒絕支付欠款，草原方面的傳統則強調薩珊先下手為強、殺了可汗的至親；兩說都承認同一件事，即薩珊自公元607年起長期以錢財買退突厥，如今買不動了。深一層的原因是形勢：自602年開戰以來，薩珊把主力壓在亞美尼亞與兩河對付拜占庭，北方防線只靠附庸與少量守軍維持，這對以劫掠為生的草原聯盟是一個難得的空檔，突厥既有利可圖，也有足夠實力南下。更遠的背景則是公元568年以來已定下的格局：東西方都曾想借助草原力量削弱波斯，而草原力量自身的分合，也讓薩珊在兩面受敵之餘多了一個可以討好、也可以交戰的對象。
causeEn: The immediate spark fell in 619. The Sasanian court detained or killed Turkic envoys and Turkic princes who had taken refuge under Persian protection, and severed the arrangements for tribute and grazing that had held until then; the two sides fell out. The exact sequence is described differently in the sources: the Byzantine tradition stresses that the Persian court was mean and refused to pay what it owed, while the steppe tradition emphasises that Persia struck first and killed a kinsman of the khagan. Both versions agree on the substance: since 607 Persia had been buying off the Turks with money, and now the money would not buy them off any more. A deeper cause is the shape of the strategic situation. Since 602 Persia had concentrated its main army in Armenia and the two rivers against Byzantium, and the northern line was held by client troops and a few garrisons. For a steppe confederation that lived on plunder this was a rare opening, and the Turks both had something to gain and the strength to march south. Further back lies the arrangement settled since 568, when both East and West had sought to use the steppe against Persia; and because the steppe powers themselves divided and reunited, Persia found that even while pressed on two fronts it had one more party it could court or fight.
impact: 短期看，薩珊為此付出的代價極重：北線要養一支用來買退草原的錢袋子，西線要養一支用來對付拜占庭的軍隊，兩者相加，國庫與人力都撐到極限；公元619年至628年之間，薩珊先後折了沙赫巴拉茲、沙欣、法魯赫·霍爾米茲德等一批能戰之將，主力在東西兩線之間被拉成薄片。突厥一方則嘗到了甜頭，兩河流域的城邑、穀倉與畜群被大批帶走，薩珊被迫續納歲幣，以北方邊界的實際控制換取和平，並接受與可汗庭的聯姻安排；薩珊在北高加索與外高加索的實控線往後退了一大步，許多附庸部眾改投突厥。中長期的影響更為深遠：這段屈辱的北約條款延續了薩珊王朝的壽命，也損害了它的體質，北方草原的壓力從此成為薩珊無法擺脫的常態，與其後薩珊同西突厥、回鶻的衝突一脈相承。對拜占庭而言，突厥在北線吸住薩珊，客觀上為皇帝騰出了兩河作戰的空間，也改變了帝國對北方盟友的估計；和約一訂，先前的盟軍旋即轉冷，其後數年草原方面的軍隊在克里米亞與高加索一線與拜占庭人亦有交鋒，這一課後來被拜占庭記了很久。
impactEn: In the short term the cost to Sasanian Persia was very heavy. The northern front had to be paid for out of a treasury that was also funding the army in the west, and both together stretched the state finances and the manpower to the limit. Between 619 and 628 Persia lost a whole series of able commanders, Shahrbaraz, Shahin, Farrukh Hormizd among them, while its main army was thinned out by being stretched between two fronts. The Turks in turn found the war profitable: towns, storehouses and herds of the two rivers were carried off in bulk, Persia was forced to continue its tribute payments, to buy peace with the actual control of its northern frontier, and to accept a marriage arrangement with the khagan's court. The Sasanian line of real control in the northern Caucasus and Transcaucasia moved a long way back, and many client peoples changed sides. The longer-term effect went deeper still. The humiliating terms on the northern flank kept the Sasanian dynasty alive while damaging its constitution, and pressure from the northern steppe became a permanent condition that Sasanian Persia could not escape, a thread that ran straight on into its later clashes with the Western Turks and the Uighurs. For Byzantium the effect was that the Turks pinned Persia in the north, which in practice freed the emperor's hands in the two rivers, and the empire's estimate of its northern ally changed with it. Once the peace was signed the former ally turned cold, and in the following years steppe forces fought Byzantine troops in the Crimea and along the Caucasian axis, a lesson the empire remembered for a long time.
result: 到公元628年，形勢逼出結局：胡斯勞二世在拜占庭的深入與自己兩個兒子的奪位中垮台，其子阿達希爾二世即位；新王朝沒有餘力再打，於是向突厥方面續約，保留歲幣與進貢安排，並以聯姻加深羈縻，北線自此安靜下來。619年這場戰爭的直接結果，是薩珊在北方邊界線上退卻：以歲幣換取突厥撤出亞美尼亞、美索不達米亞與高加索，把原屬自己的山地要塞與牧地實際讓出，換取薩珊腹地與西線的安全。這對突厥並非完勝：深入高原的草原騎兵在山地攻城中屢屢受阻，遠征的補給與馬匹汰換都比不上在家鄉撐營，加上汗國內部與西邊突騎施一系的牽制，使其無法把佔據長期化，數年後便陸續退出。對薩珊而言，真正的致命傷並不在北方，而在同年爆發的拜占庭戰線：希拉克里奧斯於公元627年12月擊潰魯斯塔姆，翌年胡斯勞二世被自己人廢殺，薩珊從此再未恢復戰前的疆界與國力。
resultEn: By 628 the situation forced an ending. Khosrow II collapsed under the Byzantine advance in the west and the usurpation of his own two sons; his son Ardashir II took the throne. The new dynasty had no strength to fight again, so it renewed the terms with the Turks, kept up the tribute and the payments, and deepened the tie with a marriage alliance, and the northern front went quiet. The direct outcome of the war that began in 619 was a Sasanian withdrawal on the northern frontier: tribute bought the departure of the Turks from Armenia, Mesopotamia and the Caucasus, and the fortresses and pastures that had been Persian were effectively given up in exchange for the security of the Persian interior and of the western front. It was not a clean victory for the Turks. Steppe horsemen deep on the plateau were repeatedly checked by mountain sieges, and the supply and horse replacement of a distant campaign could not compare with camping at home; with the khaganate itself divided and with the western Tocharish pressing on it, the Turks could not make their occupation permanent and began to withdraw again within a few years. For Sasanian Persia the mortal wound was not in the north but on the Byzantine front in the same years: Heraclius broke Rostam in December 627, and in the following year Khosrow II was deposed and killed by his own men. From then on Sasanian Persia never recovered either its pre-war frontiers or its strength.
